space_events.name: Falcon 9 launch
space_events.note: Kerosene engine, Cape Canaveral, north-east ascent
space_events.why: Fuel CO2 is about 430 t. Most of the estimate is black carbon left in the stratosphere. Factor not yet peer-reviewed.

space_events.name: Satellite re-entry
space_events.why: Main concern is aluminium oxide and ozone loss, not warming. Warming term is poorly constrained.

space_events.name: Upper-stage re-entry
space_events.why: Heavier than a satellite, so more metal vapour and alumina. Ablation products are rarely measured.

space_events.name: Methane rocket launch
space_events.why: Methane burns cleaner than kerosene, so far less soot reaches the stratosphere.
